Load penetration test on RS soil; apparatus: hydraulic LPT; loading: continuous penetration. Recorded: pressure parameter at relative depth 0.2 vs Cms.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, unit weight, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
